name: Gem-Year Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: Based in China, Gem-Year Industrial Co.,Ltd. is a prominent enterprise specializing in the research, development, manufacturing, and supply of fasteners. Its extensive product portfolio includes a wide array of fastener solutions designed for diverse applications such as railway, highway, electricity, subway, automotive, bicycle, engine, and home appliance sectors. Beyond application-specific fasteners, they also produce common items like iron nails, structural steel components, decorative screws, precision fine threads, and various casting products. In addition to fasteners, Gem-Year also supplies a comprehensive range of hardware tools. This includes general tool sets, storage solutions like toolboxes and carts, and a variety of hand tools such as wrenches (including torque wrenches), hex keys, screwdriver bits, and pliers. Their offering further extends to cutting, striking, and measuring instruments, as well as electrical, electronic, pneumatic, and hydraulic lifting tools. Established in 1995, the company maintains its headquarters in Jiaxing, China.
